reasoning:
I need to fix the subgoal instruction's motion test, since round 1 had 2 subgoal failures. The proposed fix: treat a side flip between the last two frames as moving away, and small outward drift under 5 pixels as a turnaround — though I'm wondering if that 5px threshold is overfit, since the cube slows near the far end, so maybe I should phrase the test in terms of the whole step's frame sequence instead.

I'll keep the threshold but note it's approximate, and replace the motion-detection passage with clearer actionable logic based on comparing distances across the last two frames to classify toward/away/turnaround. I'll also adjust the "remain static" fallback text to account for the case where the cube passes the target, keeping the edits minimal and outputting the result as JSON.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: - Determine the cube's motion from the last two frames shown at this step: compute |cube_x - target_x| at each; if it is decreasing, the cube is moving toward the target; if it is equal (cube stopped at the far end of its swing, same position in both frames), treat it as at the turnaround, which also counts as 'not moving away'; if it is increasing, it is moving away.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: - Determine the cube's motion from the last two frames shown at this step, in this order. (1) If the cube is on different sides of the target in those two frames, it is passing the target right now and its next motion is outward: classify it as MOVING AWAY, whatever the distances are. (2) Otherwise compute |cube_x - target_x| at each of the two frames. If it is decreasing, the cube is MOVING TOWARD the target. If it is equal, or increasing by only a small amount (fewer than about 5 px between the two frames, i.e. under about 1 px per timestep, which happens only at the far end of the swing where the cube is slowing to turn around), the cube is AT THE TURNAROUND, which counts as 'not moving away'. If it is increasing by more than that (the outward sweep after a crossing, where consecutive frames move about 7 px or more), it is MOVING AWAY.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: and crossings == N-1 while the cube is still moving away from the target.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: and crossings == N-1 while the cube is still moving away from the target (including the case where the (N-1)th crossing lies between the last two frames, so the cube is just passing the target and about to sweep outward).

revision.refused: The proposal that C may be chosen only when crossings == N-1 was already the carried-in value, with any step whose own frames contain the (N-1)th crossing answering B, is refused as the report itself recommends: a recorded press in the same minibatch occurred at a step whose frames contained the (N-1)th crossing with the cube slowed at the far end. The deciding fact is the cube's motion in the last two frames, not when the crossing was counted, so the fix is the refined motion test. No memory change is committed: both failed steps had correct crossings values and reported nothing missing from memory.
